system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 3 lbs.

No fuel burns within this lantern. Its pale light seems to illuminate empty air more brightly than walls or furniture.

The lantern produces light in a 20-foot radius. Disembodied spirits and incorporeal Undead within the light appear as faint translucent forms. This reveals their location but does not identify them.

You also gain the Open the Lantern ability:

Open the Lantern:

Activate Engage (1 AP)

For 10 minutes, you gain the effects of Veil Sight. The ability becomes expended and may be restored through Refocus.

On the sheet: Open the Lantern is Veil Sight as an innate Focus spell (Refocus restores it). Its 20-foot light and the outline of spirits within it are the table's.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

abilities.label: Open the Lantern
abilities.note: Engage (1 AP); 10 minutes; expended until Refocus
